name: Enfidha - Hammamet International Airport
before:
The holiday airport for this stretch of the Tunisian coast, at Enfidha about 40 km south west of Hammamet. Most of the traffic is European airlines bringing clients to the resorts, so the timetable is heavily seasonal.

Ground transport is the part that needs organising. There is a bus from the airport into the nearby town of Enfidha, and from there louages, the Tunisian shared taxis, run to Tunis and Sousse. For most clients a pre-booked resort transfer is the practical answer.

claims.claim: FCDO advises against all travel to parts of Tunisia
claims.why: Held back: a warning that replaces nothing. The FCDO advises against all travel to parts of Tunisia, in the Algerian border area in the west and the Libyan border area in the south (updated 24 July 2026, still current 23 September 2026). Enfidha and Hammamet are not in those areas.
